ALRM.name: Alarm Sensors
ALRM.definition: Alarm sensors, such as tamper, seismic or heat sensors.

BRCD.name: Bar Code Reader
BRCD.definition: Device scanning barcodes using any scanning technology.

CRDD.name: Card Dispenser
CRDD.definition: Device dispensing card to a consumer.

CRDR.name: Card Unit
CRDR.definition: Device to read and optionally write card with various entry modes.

CSHD.name: Cash Dispenser
CSHD.definition: Device dispensing cash in an automated environment, or with an operator present.

CSHI.name: Cash In Module
CSHI.definition: Device accepting in-out of items as coupons, documents, bills and coins.

CSHR.name: Cash Recycler
CSHR.definition: Compound device with cash in module, cash dispenser, and cash exchange.

CHCK.name: Check Reader
CHCK.definition: Check reader and check image scanner.

DPST.name: Deposit
DPST.definition: Device for the deposit of media in envelopes or deposit of bags containing bulk media.

DPRN.name: Document Printer
DPRN.definition: Printer for full-size forms documents and supporting the printing of text and graphic.

DOOR.name: Door Sensors
DOOR.definition: Door sensors, such as cabinet, safe or vandal shield doors.

JPRN.name: Journal Printer
JPRN.definition: Continuous form device used to record a hardcopy audit trail of transactions, and for certain report printing requirements.

PSBK.name: Passbook Printer
PSBK.definition: Passbook device supporting automatic positioning of the book.

PINR.name: PIN Keypad
PINR.definition: Hardware security module allowing the PIN (Personal Identification Number) entry, secure storing of cryptographic keys, and other cryptographic functions.

RPRN.name: Receipt Printer
RPRN.definition: Receipt printer used to print cut sheet documents.

SCAN.name: Scanner Printer
SCAN.definition: Device incorporating both the capabilities to scan inserted documents and optionally to print on them.
